Name: Big Apricot
Author: oclarina
Description:
Changes the visual of the apricot so that it's bigger. Or, optionally changes it so the apricot is even smaller and more off-center, based on a config value.

Should be compatible with just about everything. It probably won't even break the game if you have other mods that change what the apricot looks like. I just can't guarantee which apricot appearance will prevail.

(This mod may not-so-secretly just be a ploy to inspire someone else to make apricot furniture or clothes because I think it would be cute.)
